description: Bind Hermes installation and fresh sessions to the resolved AGRO workspace.

userStories.title: Set the workspace during install and repair
userStories.description: As an operator, I want installation to set the terminal workspace so that fresh sessions run commands in my checkout.
acceptanceCriteria: First installation sets `terminal.cwd` through `hermes config set` in `<target-root>/.hermes` before reporting success.
Existing installations repair missing or stale cwd without downloading the executable again.
Local and host paths use the resolved workspace; Docker uses `/home/sandbox/harness`.
Configuration failures return a nonzero exit status and an actionable diagnostic without an installation-success message.
Conflicting runtime homes receive explicit selection guidance; installation preserves credentials and unrelated state.
Tests cover default, recorded, and explicit workspace selection, repair, configuration failure, and non-Hermes installation.
Regression tests fail before the fix and pass after the fix.
userStories.notes:
AC1: Executed: installation/repair target tests and real helper configuration via supported Hermes CLI passed; configuration happens before success.
AC2: Executed: already-installed tests verify one configure call and no installer invocation.
AC3: Executed: local/host/default/recorded/explicit roots and Docker container argv contracts passed.
AC4: Executed: configuration failure tests returned nonzero and suppressed success; literal printed recovery command passed unchanged.
AC5: Executed: inherited/default-home conflict tests reject before mutation; state-preservation fixtures and no-migration source review passed.
AC6: Executed: 130 targeted tests and 1901 full-suite tests passed; non-Hermes harness tests remained green.
AC7: Executed: documented regression red/green and final independent review passed; no security or logic findings.
Integrated review repairs: 9c054337 and 0d45625e; independent review passed with empty concerns/errors.

userStories.title: Align the launch contract and gateway
userStories.description: As an operator, I want launches to select the workspace home so that installation and gateway sessions use the same configuration.
acceptanceCriteria: Interactive launch guidance explicitly selects `<workspace>/.hermes`; documentation states that bare `hermes` does not bind a workspace.
Gateway startup sets cwd through the supported Hermes configuration interface and returns configuration failures before starting tmux.
Installation and gateway startup use the same target-root and runtime-home contract without a second YAML editor.
Explicit gateway home and cwd overrides remain documented; conflicting inherited homes receive a diagnostic before mutation.
Configuration, authentication, secrets, memory, skills, and session files remain unchanged except for the selected terminal cwd and existing provider-link repair.
Documentation explains safe home selection and restarting an existing gateway; installation does not restart the live gateway.
Tests verify launch environment selection and failure handling; the changelog links issue #1344.
userStories.notes:
AC1: Executed: launch guidance tests and documentation review verify explicit workspace HERMES_HOME; bare upstream launcher remains unchanged.
AC2: Executed: gateway config CLI tests reject failure before tmux; shared helper runtime config readback passed.
AC3: Executed: shared target-side home/cwd helper is used by installation and gateway; no second YAML writer remains.
AC4: Executed: explicit gateway overrides, configured fallback-home conflicts, and normalized-path tests passed.
AC5: Executed: credential/runtime fixture files stayed byte-identical; legacy-only and empty canonical Teams keys get key-only rejection.
AC6: Reasoned: source and documentation show no automatic live gateway restart; active home and upstream checkout remained untouched in verification.
AC7: Executed: gateway/diagnostic/quoted-path tests passed; docs/changelog link issue1344; STE passed.
Integrated review repairs: 9c054337 and 0d45625e; independent review passed with empty concerns/errors.

userStories.title: Record fresh-session and failure evidence
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I want executable evidence so that reviewers can verify the workspace contract without trusting installer output.
acceptanceCriteria: A run uses installed Hermes with an isolated runtime home; a fresh terminal session starts in the selected workspace.
The run starts outside the selected workspace and does not use a previous session-level `cd` as evidence.
Evidence records commands, actual output, exit status, a failure path, and cleanup in `.agro/tasks/hermes-workspace-binding/evidence/manual-review.md`.
The local run does not use provider credentials, send Slack messages, alter the active Hermes home, or restart the live gateway.
Repository tests, typecheck, build, and the configured lint command exit 0; the evidence reports unavailable checks as blockers.
userStories.notes:
AC1: Executed: installed Hermes with isolated HOME/HERMES_HOME and fresh UUID terminal IDs returned workspace after repair; sectionF records actual output.
AC2: Executed: probes started outside fixture workspace with no workdir or prior cd; original auto fallback returned fixture HOME.
AC3: Executed: reproducible driver, exact output, exit statuses, relative/missing failure, timeout17 preservation, and cleanup recorded in committed evidence.
